ex.en: I don't care if you trust me or not.
ex.zh: 我不在乎你信不信任我。

ex.en: To what extent can he be trusted?
ex.zh: 他可以信任到什麼程度？

ex.en: No one trusts him any more.
ex.zh: 沒有人再相信他了。

ex.en: Trust is important in any relationship.
ex.zh: 信任在任何關係中都很重要。

ex.en: It takes years to build trust.
ex.zh: 建立信任需要好幾年。

ex.en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
ex.zh: 我喜歡這件裙子，可以試穿嗎？

ex.en: Can I try on this pair of shoes?
ex.zh: 我可以試穿這雙鞋嗎？

ex.en: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
ex.zh: 我想試穿這件，請問試衣間在哪裡？

ex.en: The bank charges a fee for each transaction.
ex.zh: 銀行每筆交易都會收手續費。

ex.en: Check your recent transactions in the app.
ex.zh: 在 App 裡查看最近的交易紀錄。

ex.en: But I haven't looked up this tracking number on the DHL website.
ex.zh: 可是我還沒在 DHL 網站上查這個追蹤號碼。

ex.en: You'll receive a tracking number by email.
ex.zh: 您會透過電子郵件收到追蹤號碼。

ex.en: Some items were damaged in transit.
ex.zh: 有些物品在運送途中損壞了。

ex.en: Passengers in transit do not need a visa.
ex.zh: 過境旅客不需要簽證。

ex.en: Public transit in Taipei is fast and cheap.
ex.zh: 台北的大眾運輸又快又便宜。

ex.en: The city is investing in mass transit.
ex.zh: 這座城市正在投資大眾運輸系統。

ex.en: We will show our new products at the trade show.
ex.zh: 我們會在商展上展示新產品。

ex.en: The Computex trade show is held in Taipei every year.
ex.zh: 台北國際電腦展每年在台北舉行。

ex.en: Training will be provided.
ex.zh: 公司會提供訓練。

ex.en: No matter how hard the training was, she never cried.
ex.zh: 不管訓練多麼艱苦，她都沒有哭過。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年艱苦的訓練，她終於有所突破，奪得冠軍。

ex.en: I work in a travel agency.
ex.zh: 我在旅行社工作.

ex.en: Where's the nearest travel agency?
ex.zh: 最近的旅行社在哪裡？

ex.en: The IT team helped me troubleshoot my laptop.
ex.zh: 資訊部門幫我排除筆電的問題。

ex.en: This guide explains how to troubleshoot common problems.
ex.zh: 這份指南說明如何排除常見問題。

ex.en: Do I need to transfer?
ex.zh: 我需要轉車嗎？

ex.en: Is it convenient to transfer between the subway and the light rail here?
ex.zh: 在這裡轉乘捷運和輕軌方便嗎？

ex.en: Could you please transfer me to Mr. Smith?
ex.zh: 請幫我轉接Smith先生。

ex.en: Please stay on the line while your call is transferred to a customer service representative.
ex.zh: 您的電話正在轉接給客服代表，請不要結束通話。

ex.en: Tsung-han got transferred to the Kaohsiung branch. I heard the pay's good.
ex.zh: 宗翰最近被調去高雄分公司，聽說待遇不錯。

ex.en: Sami was transferred from customer service.
ex.zh: 薩米是從客服部門調來的。

ex.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
ex.zh: 我們會用銀行轉帳付款。

ex.en: A bank transfer usually takes one business day.
ex.zh: 銀行轉帳通常需要一個工作天。

ex.en: The train from Geneva will arrive at the station.
ex.zh: 從日內瓦來的火車就要進站了。

ex.en: You will not be able to catch the train.
ex.zh: 你會趕不上火車。

ex.en: What time does the train for New York depart?
ex.zh: 去紐約的火車幾點出發？

ex.en: Musical talent can be developed if it's properly trained.
ex.zh: 如果訓練得當的話，音樂才能是可以培養出來的。

ex.en: She trains three times a week for the marathon.
ex.zh: 她每週訓練三次，準備跑馬拉松。

ex.en: The traffic light turned green.
ex.zh: 紅綠燈變成綠色了。

ex.en: Turn right at the first traffic light.
ex.zh: 在第一個紅綠燈右轉。

ex.en: Go forward, then turn right, go through the traffic light, and you're there.
ex.zh: 你往前走，然後往右轉，過了紅綠燈就到了。

ex.en: Mid-Autumn Day is a traditional holiday in China.
ex.zh: 中秋節是中國的傳統節日。

ex.en: Sumo is the traditional sport of Japan.
ex.zh: 相撲是日本傳統的體育活動。

ex.en: Christmas gingerbread, also called honey cake, is a traditional German dessert.
ex.zh: 聖誕薑餅是一種傳統的德國點心。

ex.en: The company promised to be transparent about its finances.
ex.zh: 公司承諾公開透明地揭露財務狀況。

ex.en: We need a more transparent hiring process.
ex.zh: 我們需要更透明的招募流程。

ex.en: The box is made of transparent plastic.
ex.zh: 這個盒子是用透明塑膠做的。

ex.en: The water was so clear it was almost transparent.
ex.zh: 水清澈得幾乎透明。

ex.en: She's highly influenced by current trends.
ex.zh: 她深受當下潮流影響。

ex.en: Don't follow the trends.
ex.zh: 不要盲目追趕潮流。

ex.en: Online shopping is a growing trend.
ex.zh: 網路購物是一個持續成長的趨勢。

ex.en: I'm tracking a buck.
ex.zh: 我正在追蹤一頭公鹿。

ex.en: You can track your package online.
ex.zh: 你可以在網路上追蹤包裹。

ex.en: The tracks run parallel to the road.
ex.zh: 鐵軌和公路平行。

ex.en: The runners lined up on the track.
ex.zh: 跑者在跑道上排好。

ex.en: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
ex.zh: 他們在雪地裡找到了熊的腳印。

ex.en: The hunter followed the bear's tracks.
ex.zh: 獵人跟著熊的蹤跡。

track.zh: on the right track：走在正確的方向上

ex.en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
ex.zh: 我的生意終於上軌道了。

ex.en: Keep going. You're on the right track.
ex.zh: 繼續努力，你的方向是對的。
